card: This pull request migrates native Windows builds and CI from MSVC (cl.exe) to clang-cl, dropping support for compiling with cl.exe. Switching to clang-cl resolves persistent MSVC-specific bugs (#31456, #36153) and unblocks inline assembly optimizations on Windows. Author benchmarks report a ~55% improvement in block connection throughput and reduced Windows CI build times from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. Native Windows developers will need the clang-cl toolset installed through Visual Studio or LLVM.
changed_since_previous: Added commit f8e5906015 to treat warnings as errors in CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags, switched x86 SHA-NI flag from -msse4 to -msse4.1 to satisfy the clang-cl frontend, and rebased onto #36554.

enables: Hardware-accelerated inline assembly on Windows (e.g. secp256k1 #1681)

evidence: Author benchmarks show block connection performance improves by roughly 55% to 60% with clang-cl compared to MSVC (e.g., ConnectBlockAllEcdsa from 7.40 to 11.52 block/s; DeserializeBlockTest from 121.46 to 189.04 block/s)
Author CI measurements show a reduction in Windows CI job runtimes from 20m 35s under MSVC to 12m 43s under clang-cl (run 13792522864)
Closes issues #31456 and #36153 regarding MSVC compiler bugs and allows removal of MSVC-specific workarounds in tests and byteswap handling
problem: Compiling with MSVC creates ongoing maintenance overhead due to compiler-specific bugs and internal compiler errors (#31456, #36153), lacks inline assembly support on x64 and ARM64 processors, and produces slower binaries with longer compilation times than Clang.

risk.why: Alters compiler toolchain, compiler flags, and runtime library linking for all native Windows builds, which could introduce build regressions or runtime instability on Windows.

scope_notes: Drops MSVC (cl.exe) support entirely for native Windows compilation in CMake; native Windows developers must have the ClangCL toolset installed via Visual Studio or LLVM.
summary: Native Windows builds and CI are migrated from MSVC (cl.exe) to LLVM's clang-cl toolset, dropping support for compiling with cl.exe. CMake presets, warning flags, feature introspection tests, and documentation are updated for clang-cl, and Windows binaries are linked against Clang's builtins runtime library. Workarounds for MSVC compiler bugs and constexpr restrictions in byteswap and util tests are removed.
